description: This file is a shell script that performs testing of various git replay functionalities, including rebasing, cherry-picking, handling conflicts, branch manipulations, and configuration options. It sets up git repositories, executes commands, and verifies expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message or changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test expecting success with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks that the output contains a specific number of lines.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file or stream.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or streams for equality.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or tests git configuration options.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output.
